source: Owned apps/admin Web application rendered in headless Chromium
data: Entirely fictional browser-local API fixtures: 星河商贸, 经营分析助手, 第三季度经营复盘. No real account, user profile, API credential or business record is used.
presentation: These are actual Web UI captures with demonstration data, not native Electron or Android captures and not proof of a live Agent execution.
captureMethod: Fresh temporary browser contexts; all API v2 HTTP and WebSocket requests intercepted; no DOM or product styles replaced. Screenshot PNGs encoded as WebP without compositing.
